description: Reference payload for compiling the EBB token smart contract. EBB extends SmartContract and implements BasicStandard (Credits canonical token interface) — burn() and setFrozen() come from the interface. Total supply: 1,000,000 EBB; decimals: 18.
notes: The actual deployed source lives in /contracts/EBB.java — this payload is an illustrative reference for the Compile endpoint. The first import MUST remain `com.credits.scapi.v0.SmartContract;` for the executor compilation to succeed.
